The corridor passes through danger at (88.2,88.6) — chaser:wallflyer@64,80 (the wallflyer's contact: its `hitPlayer` gate fires against the player's start-of-tick box THIS tick (body at (83.0,88.0), forecast along the walk)) — and every rung of ⚖ §11.8a's order refused:
  avoid: the danger-forbidden corridor STILL probes dangerous at (88.2,88.6) — chaser:wallflyer@64,80 (the wallflyer's contact: its `hitPlayer` gate fires against the player's start-of-tick box THIS tick (body at (83.0,88.0), forecast along the walk)). ⚠ The AVOID rung routes around RECTS and the probe asks the whole union, which includes the point tests a rect cannot carry (a disc hazard); that gap is why the ladder has a second rung.
  dodge: no stall of 1..30 tick(s) at any walk-offset 11..0 (step 4) clears the corridor of chaser:wallflyer@64,80 (the wallflyer's contact: its `hitPlayer` gate fires against the player's start-of-tick box THIS tick (body at (83.0,88.0), forecast along the walk))
  time: the aim is 115 px away and `mover.MOVER_RANGE` measures this search reaching 48 px as an UPPER BOUND at dwell 4. TIME is the contested LAST-MILE tool (kickoff §3.1); it is not a room-crossing one, and the bound is named rather than widened.
  bait: level 22 has NO region that kills a body — no armed trap lane, no lethal terrain, no pit. A bait needs somewhere for the line to cross.
  kill: no presser in level 22 arms a trap whose lane covers bob@96,144 — the room has 0 presser(s) and 0 trap(s), and a button that arms nothing over the body is not a weapon. A PRESS arm is a `KILL_ARM_POLICY` question and this rung does not open one (trap 101).
         chaser arm: this run holds no sword, so `set slashing`'s outer gate refuses every press — no stance could strike bob@96,144, and the stance scan was not run (SF3)
  detour: deadline — the caller's anytime deadline (`shouldStop`) was reached in the DETOUR search after 253 preview(s) and 445 leg(s), so the rest of the search was not run
  forced-hit: no forced hit is proven from (88.2,99.2): the caller's deadline tripped inside the proof's fork (0 fork step(s)) ⏱ DEADLINE: the caller's `shouldStop` tripped (first at `detour`) and refused 1 `detour` scan(s), 1 `crusher-fork` scan(s) — this refusal may be the deadline's, not the room's.
